title: Bar counter dressed with shootable glass
what: The bar car is a carpet runner down the middle between two long stone-topped counters at half a body, with dining booths outside them and framed tapestries on the walls. Along the counter tops stand wine glasses and bottles of several colours, spaced a hand apart; each is a breakable object, so a gunfight here shatters the bar with glass sounds. Cultists stand in the aisle and behind the counters, where the shape of the room makes the counters cover.
recipe: Aisle sector 6: 2048 wide (3.6 m), 25 m long, floor tile 308 (patterned carpet runner), 1.93 bodies high. Counters: sectors 218-221, 512 deep, floor 0 (0.48 bodies above the aisle floor 8192), floor tile 43 (stone top), walls 2453. Bar backs 22/25 behind them at aisle level, holding ammo pickups (TNT bundles type 62, shells type 67). Glass: face sprites tile 574 (drinking glass, 13x25 px), 605/606 (bottles), 759 (bottle, recoloured with pal 4 and pal 12), cstat 385, type 416 kThingObjectGib, data_1 1, data_4 301 (glass), standing on the counter top at z 0. Tapestries: wall art on wall tile 109.
use: The saloon: line every bar top and shelf with breakable glasses and bottles (tile 574, 605, 606, 759 as type 416) so the first shot in the room makes a mess. Also theatre bar, hotel lobby.
